sources.quote: Kepler-296e is a confirmed super-Earth exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of Kepler-296.

introduction.text: It is one of 5 planets known around Kepler-296. Its orbit and size follow Barclay et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-296e"
sources.quote: The planet was discovered by NASA's Kepler spacecraft using the transit method, in which the dimming effect that a planet causes as it crosses in front of its star is measured.
